user.title: Tuya P2 Mesh
user.description: Select the Bluetooth adapter dedicated to this integration and confirm the P2 source settings.

scan.title: Discover a P2 bulb
scan.description: Select a discovered bulb, or enter its MAC address manually.

device.title: Bulb details
device.description: Enter the bulb's Bluetooth address, node ID, local key, and a friendly name.

capture.title: Capture the beacon key
capture.description: Toggle the bulb OFF and ON in the Tuya app while this step watches for both frames. You can also enter the beacon key manually.

test.title: Test the bulb
test.description: Confirm that the bulb turned on and off in response to the test command.

data.confirmed: The bulb responded to the test

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Tuya P2 Mesh
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the updated adapter, beacon key, or local key.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Tuya P2 Mesh
reconfigure.description: Update the adapter, source ID, beacon key, or a bulb's local key.

error.cannot_connect: The Bluetooth adapter could not be opened. Check the adapter name and permissions.
error.capture_failed: Could not capture a matching OFF/ON frame pair. Toggle the bulb again or enter the beacon key manually.
error.no_devices: No P2 bulbs were discovered. Try again or enter the bulb manually.
error.invalid_mac: Enter a valid Bluetooth MAC address.
error.invalid_key: The key must be 16 ASCII characters or 32 hexadecimal digits.
error.invalid_name: Enter a name for the bulb.
error.invalid_node_id: Enter a node ID between 0 and 65535.
error.duplicate_mac: A bulb with this MAC address is already configured.
error.invalid_source_id: Enter a source ID between 0 and 65535.
error.invalid_sequence_seed: Enter a sequence seed between 0 and 65535.
error.test_failed: The test command could not be sent. Check the adapter and try again.

init.title: Tuya P2 Mesh options
init.description: Configured bulbs: {bulbs}. Add another bulb or update the integration settings.

add_device.title: Add a bulb
add_device.description: Enter the new bulb's Bluetooth address, node ID, local key, and a friendly name.
